query:
INSERT INTO `businesses` (`name`, `slug`, `description`, `shortDescription`, `sportCategoryId`, `businessTypeId`, `city`, `state`, `country`, `isClaimed`, `isActive`, `isFeatured`) VALUES
('Summit Cycling Coaching', 'summit-cycling-coaching', 'Expert cycling coaching for road, gravel, and mountain biking. Personalized training plans for all levels from beginners to elite racers.', 'Expert cycling coaching for all levels', 1, 1, 'Boulder', 'Colorado', 'USA', false, true, true),
('Trailhead Bike Works', 'trailhead-bike-works', 'Full-service bike shop specializing in mountain and gravel bikes. Expert mechanics, custom builds, and a wide selection of gear.', 'Full-service bike shop for MTB and gravel', 1, 2, 'Moab', 'Utah', 'USA', false, true, false),
('Alpine Run Club', 'alpine-run-club', 'Community trail running club with weekly group runs, training programs, and race preparation for all distances.', 'Community trail running club', 2, 5, 'Chamonix', '', 'France', false, true, true),
('Peak Performance Physio', 'peak-performance-physio', 'Sports physiotherapy clinic specializing in endurance athletes. Injury prevention, rehabilitation, and performance optimization.', 'Sports physio for endurance athletes', 1, 7, 'Denver', 'Colorado', 'USA', false, true, false),
('Powder Line Ski School', 'powder-line-ski-school', 'Professional ski instruction for all ages and abilities. From first-timers to advanced backcountry skiing.', 'Professional ski instruction for all levels', 3, 12, 'Whistler', 'British Columbia', 'Canada', false, true, true),
('Endurance Fuel Nutrition', 'endurance-fuel-nutrition', 'Sports nutrition consulting for endurance athletes. Race-day fueling strategies, daily nutrition plans, and supplement guidance.', 'Sports nutrition for endurance athletes', 2, 9, 'Portland', 'Oregon', 'USA', false, true, false),
('Iron Legs Sports Massage', 'iron-legs-sports-massage', 'Deep tissue and sports massage therapy focused on recovery for cyclists, runners, and skiers.', 'Sports massage for endurance athletes', 1, 8, 'Park City', 'Utah', 'USA', false, true, false),
('Velocity Cycling Studio', 'velocity-cycling-studio', 'High-energy indoor cycling studio with structured power-based training. Classes for all fitness levels.', 'Indoor cycling studio with power training', 1, 4, 'Austin', 'Texas', 'USA', false, true, false),
('Nordic Edge Ski Shop', 'nordic-edge-ski-shop', 'Specialist nordic skiing equipment. Cross-country skis, boots, wax, and expert fitting services.', 'Nordic skiing equipment specialists', 3, 11, 'Minneapolis', 'Minnesota', 'USA', false, true, false),
('Trail Blazer Running Store', 'trail-blazer-running-store', 'Trail running gear specialists. Expert shoe fitting, hydration packs, and everything for the trail.', 'Trail running gear specialists', 2, 3, 'Bend', 'Oregon', 'USA', false, true, false),
('Mountain Fit Personal Training', 'mountain-fit-personal-training', 'Strength and conditioning for mountain athletes. Ski-specific, cycling, and running performance programs.', 'S&C for mountain athletes', 3, 10, 'Jackson', 'Wyoming', 'USA', false, true, false),
('Ride Right Bike Fitting', 'ride-right-bike-fitting', 'Professional bike fitting using 3D motion capture. Optimize comfort and performance on any bike.', 'Professional 3D bike fitting', 1, 13, 'San Francisco', 'California', 'USA', false, true, false);
